d:
Relive the monsoon magic with “Saawan Barasta Hai”, the romantic gem from the 1990 film Shandaar starring Mithun Chakraborty and Meenakshi Seshadri. Sung beautifully by Mohammed Aziz and Anuradha Paudwal, this melodious track captures the essence of love in the rain—Bollywood-style!
Saawan Barasta Hai | Mithun, Meenakshi | Shandaar (1990) | Mohammed Aziz | Romantic Monsoon Song
Song : Saawan Barasta Hai
Movie: Shandaar (1990)
Cast : Mithun Chakraborty, Meenakshi Seshadri, Juhi Chawla
Singers: Mohammed Aziz, Anuradha Paudwal
Music Director: Bappi Lahiri
Lyricist: Hassan Puri
